title: Ringo Starr – songs, albums, biography, photos and more!
content:
Beatle people » Ringo Starr
I had this dream at 13 to play drums, nothing else, play drums. And when I got to play the drums, when I finally got a set when I was nearly 18, I wanted to play with good people and I started playing with the best band at the time, and then the next best band and then the biggest band, the best band of all.
Ringo Starr

        Published: 14 March 2008 | Last updated: 5 September 2025
